provider.name: Genome Taxonomy Database
provider.organization_type: genome-based bacterial and archaeal taxonomy, phylogenomics, species-cluster, nomenclature, metadata, release, and classification system
provider.description: The Genome Taxonomy Database provides a standardized genome-based taxonomy for Bacteria and Archaea. It integrates public genome assemblies, genome quality, phylogenomic marker sets, relative evolutionary divergence, ANI-based species clusters, representative genomes, nomenclatural information, release archives, metadata, and GTDB-Tk classification resources.
institutional_context: NCBI GenBank and RefSeq genome assemblies
International prokaryotic nomenclature and genome-taxonomy community

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting GTDB documentation, taxonomic and phylogenomic methods, species-cluster definitions, genome metadata, release files, historical versions, GTDB-Tk manuals, APIs, source code, citations, licenses, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: GTDB, GTDB-Tk, the Australian Centre for Ecogenomics, release archives, NCBI source assemblies, cited nomenclatural authorities, and software repositories remain authoritative for classifications, genome metadata, methods, versions, licenses, citations, and contact information.
